<template>
  <el-dialog title="停止容器" v-model="dialogVisible" width="600px">
    <el-form :model="container" label-width="80px" class="container-form">
      <el-form-item label="容器名称" :rules="[{ required: true, message: '请输入容器名称', trigger: 'blur' }]">
        <el-input v-model="container.name" placeholder="请输入要停止的容器名称" />
      </el-form-item>
    </el-form>

    <template #footer>
      <el-button type="danger" @click="submitStop">停 止</el-button>
      <el-button @click="dialogVisible = false">取 消</el-button>
    </template>
  </el-dialog>
</template>

<script setup>
import { ref, defineExpose } from 'vue'
import axios from 'axios'
import {ElMessage} from "element-plus";

const dialogVisible = ref(false)

const container = ref({
  name: ''
})

// 打开弹窗
const openDialog = () => {
  container.value.name = ''
  dialogVisible.value = true
}

// 提交停止请求
const submitStop = async () => {
  if (!container.value.name) {
    alert('请输入容器名称')
    return
  }

  try {
    const response = await axios.post(`http://localhost:8081/container/stop/${encodeURIComponent(container.value.name)}`)
    dialogVisible.value = false
    ElMessage.success(`停止成功：${response.data}`)
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('停止容器出错：', error)
    ElMessage.error('停止失败：' + (error.response?.data || error.message))
  }
}

// 向父组件暴露方法
defineExpose({ openDialog })
</script>

<style scoped>
.container-form {
  padding-top: 10px;
}
</style>
